column1: # INACTIVE JC1060 16-MiB AROS kernel+BSP A/B layout candidate.
# Not selected by board.mk; do not flash with the current boot path.
# PHY data and alignment gaps. It is not a 128-KiB bootloader executable.
# Application subtype selects the kernel slot; custom BSP subtype identifies
# its matching package. Pair selection/commit/rollback is not implemented yet.
# DEVELOP is independent of both BSP slots
